lines: Hollins has played 6 of New England's 10 games and been on the field for 70% of snaps this season.
He averages 5.3 targets a game, an 18% target share, and 9.7 PPR points per game this season.
New England has a bye in Wk 11, and the coach said Hollins will return to practice this week as the team works him back in.
